title: Input-value constraint
statement: Given a Boolean-valued function $v$ on atoms and a bit $s$, define an optional bit to be absent if $s=1$ and the zero-index atom is false under $v$; otherwise, if the index-less-than-input-length atom is true under $v$, return the value of the input-bit atom, and return no value in all other cases.
